{"initiative":"Automate low-threshold spend approvals to remove manual approvals within nine months","work_packages":[{"id":"WP-01","title":"Current-state mapping of spend approval process","owner_role":"Business Process Analyst","duration_quarters":1,"deliverable":"Process map and control matrix documenting existing manual approval points and deviation records"},{"id":"WP-02","title":"Requirements and compliance specification","owner_role":"Compliance Lead","duration_quarters":1,"deliverable":"Requirements specification and compliance checklist defining acceptable automation scope, audit trails, and non-conformance handling"},{"id":"WP-03","title":"Solution design and vendor selection","owner_role":"Solutions Architect","duration_quarters":2,"deliverable":"Design package and procurement recommendation including technical design, control integration, and supplier sign-off"},{"id":"WP-04","title":"Implementation and integration","owner_role":"IT Delivery Manager","duration_quarters":2,"deliverable":"Deployed automation deliverable integrated with ERP, with configuration control and test evidence"},{"id":"WP-05","title":"Validation, user training and transition to BAU","owner_role":"Transition Manager","duration_quarters":1,"deliverable":"Validation report, training records, updated procedures and formal gate review sign-off for operational handover"}],"approval_chain":[{"gate":"G1","name":"Initiation gate review","approver_role":"Head of Finance","criteria":"Approve scope, threshold definition and initial process map; must evidence control gaps and mitigation plan for any identified deviation"},{"gate":"G2","name":"Design and procurement gate review","approver_role":"Chief Compliance Officer","criteria":"Approve requirements specification and selected solution; confirm audit trail, data retention and non-conformance handling meet regulatory requirements"},{"gate":"G3","name":"Pre-deployment gate review","approver_role":"CIO","criteria":"Approve implementation plan, integration test results and rollback plan; accept operational controls and monitoring metrics"},{"gate":"G4","name":"Operational handover sign-off","approver_role":"Director of Operations","criteria":"Approve validation report, training completion and transition to business-as-usual with documented sign-off on deliverable and control effectiveness"}],"compliance_notes":["Automation must maintain immutable audit trails and meet record retention policies; any deviation from specified controls requires documented corrective action"],"risks":[{"risk":"Insufficient control design leading to unauthorized spend","mitigation":"Build segregation of duties into solution, require multi-factor approval for exceptions and perform post-deployment sampling audits","severity":"high"},{"risk":"Integration failure with ERP causing transaction delays","mitigation":"Use staged integration, maintain manual fallback procedure and perform end-to-end testing prior to production cutover","severity":"medium"},{"risk":"User resistance and procedural non-conformance after rollout","mitigation":"Deliver role-based training, clear procedure updates and monitor compliance metrics with targeted remediation","severity":"low"}],"timeline_horizon":"9 months from initiation, with quarterly gate reviews aligned to work package durations"}

{"initiative":"Reduce dependence on single core workflow vendor through qualified alternatives and controlled transition","work_packages":[{"id":"WP-01","title":"Assess current vendor dependency and risks","owner_role":"Supply Chain Risk Manager","duration_quarters":1,"deliverable":"Work package report quantifying dependency, single points of failure, and non-conformance history"},{"id":"WP-02","title":"Identify and qualify alternative vendors","owner_role":"Procurement Qualification Lead","duration_quarters":2,"deliverable":"Approved list of qualified alternative vendors with control evidence and supplier audits"},{"id":"WP-03","title":"Develop transition and dual-sourcing plan","owner_role":"Program Transition Manager","duration_quarters":2,"deliverable":"Transition plan with staged dual-sourcing milestones and gate review criteria"},{"id":"WP-04","title":"Execute pilot transfers to alternative suppliers","owner_role":"Manufacturing Transfer Lead","duration_quarters":2,"deliverable":"Pilot deliverable: validated production runs from alternate vendors with quality sign-off"},{"id":"WP-05","title":"Implement full-scale diversification and process controls","owner_role":"Operations Compliance Manager","duration_quarters":2,"deliverable":"Operationalised multi-vendor process, updated procedures, and control checklists"}],"approval_chain":[{"gate":"G1","name":"Initiation gate review","approver_role":"Head of Supply Chain","criteria":"Approve assessment and accept risk quantification allowing progression to supplier qualification"},{"gate":"G2","name":"Qualification gate review","approver_role":"Director of Procurement","criteria":"Approve qualified vendor list and audit evidence; sign-off required to commence transition pilots"},{"gate":"G3","name":"Pilot acceptance gate review","approver_role":"Chief Operating Officer","criteria":"Accept pilot deliverable demonstrating matched performance and no critical non-conformance before scale-up"},{"gate":"G4","name":"Deployment gate review","approver_role":"Compliance and Quality Director","criteria":"Final sign-off on full-scale implementation, documented controls, and updated procedures to close the initiative"}],"compliance_notes":["All activities will follow regulated supplier qualification protocols and be documented for audit trail","Deviations from approved plans must be logged and managed through formal deviation control with root-cause documented"],"risks":[{"risk":"Delays in qualifying alternate vendors leading to extended single-vendor exposure","mitigation":"Prioritise parallel qualification tracks, allocate dedicated resources, and escalate at gate review if timelines slip","severity":"high"},{"risk":"Alternate vendors fail to meet quality or regulatory requirements","mitigation":"Require pre-qualification audits, sample validation, and contingency retention of incumbent supplier until acceptance criteria met","severity":"medium"},{"risk":"Internal process resistance causing slow adoption of multi-vendor controls","mitigation":"Mandate training, publish revised procedures, and include compliance metrics in functional performance reviews","severity":"low"}],"timeline_horizon":"12 quarters"}
